VSEC.description: Virtual Section (VSEC). Defines a virtual section for a virtual beam via a centroid point, a section normal vector, and the lists of nodes and elements it spans; all fields are set unconditionally in the write path.

CENT_CALC_TYPE.description: Centroid calculation type code (integer). Governs how the centroid point is determined; 0 is the typical value.

CEN_PT_X.description: Centroid X coordinate in the global coordinate system.

CEN_PT_Y.description: Centroid Y coordinate in the global coordinate system.

CEN_PT_Z.description: Centroid Z coordinate in the global coordinate system.

NORMAL_X.description: X component of the section normal (direction) vector.

NORMAL_Y.description: Y component of the section normal (direction) vector.

NORMAL_Z.description: Z component of the section normal (direction) vector.

NODE_LIST.description: List of node numbers that define the virtual section cut.

ELEM_LIST.description: List of element numbers associated with the virtual section.
